description: Shadow forecasts and independent validation of the bias-correction methods (scripts/bias_validation.py, docs/47). Cycles are matched by initialization month and season, so future cycle files (e.g. config/cycles/feb_2027_fmam.json) are covered without editing this file. Shadow forecasts are never published as forecasts.

shadow.reason: Square-root MVS is confirmed better than MVS for the published February probabilities of this cycle (full pipeline, Holm across all methods and targets); the shadow builds independent evidence before any change.
